This notebook:

- replicates the TWFE specifications of Bentancor and Clarke (2017)

- computes the De Chaisemartin & D'Haultfoeuille (2020) diagnostics

- runs the two spillover robustness checks,

- re-estimates TWFE on the switcher-excluded restricted sample, and

- re-estimates TWFE with the current-year pill instead of its one-year lag (timing check), and with the one-year lag on the same rows (like-for-like comparison)

Please make sure to run `Data_Process.ipynb` beforehand to generate the necessary input data.

## Libraries & Configurations

```{r}
# Clear the workspace
rm(list = ls())
```

## Load Data

```{r}
# Load the processed municipality x year panels saved by Data_Process.ipynb
read_panel <- function(name) {
  read.csv(paste0(DIR_DATA_PROC, name, ".csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
    mutate(dom_comuna = factor(dom_comuna))
}

data_age1    <- read_panel("data_age1")
data_age2    <- read_panel("data_age2")
data_age3    <- read_panel("data_age3")
data_age1_cp <- read_panel("data_age1_cp")
data_age2_cp <- read_panel("data_age2_cp")
data_age3_cp <- read_panel("data_age3_cp")
```

```{r}
# Restricted samples, selected with the indicators in the panels (droplevels() drops the municipalities that are no longer in the sample)
#   _sp:   spillover-excluded (is_spillover == 0)
#   _ns:   switcher-excluded (is_switcher == 0)
#   _cpns: current-pill data, switcher-excluded
#   _lg:   lagged-pill data on the same rows as the current-pill data (in_cp == 1); _lgns: switcher-excluded
data_age1_sp   <- data_age1 |> filter(is_spillover == 0) |> droplevels()
data_age2_sp   <- data_age2 |> filter(is_spillover == 0) |> droplevels()
data_age3_sp   <- data_age3 |> filter(is_spillover == 0) |> droplevels()

data_age1_ns   <- data_age1 |> filter(is_switcher == 0) |> droplevels()
data_age2_ns   <- data_age2 |> filter(is_switcher == 0) |> droplevels()
data_age3_ns   <- data_age3 |> filter(is_switcher == 0) |> droplevels()

data_age1_cpns <- data_age1_cp |> filter(is_switcher == 0) |> droplevels()
data_age2_cpns <- data_age2_cp |> filter(is_switcher == 0) |> droplevels()
data_age3_cpns <- data_age3_cp |> filter(is_switcher == 0) |> droplevels()

data_age1_lg   <- data_age1 |> filter(in_cp == 1) |> droplevels()
data_age2_lg   <- data_age2 |> filter(in_cp == 1) |> droplevels()
data_age3_lg   <- data_age3 |> filter(in_cp == 1) |> droplevels()

data_age1_lgns <- data_age1 |> filter(in_cp == 1, is_switcher == 0) |> droplevels()
data_age2_lgns <- data_age2 |> filter(in_cp == 1, is_switcher == 0) |> droplevels()
data_age3_lgns <- data_age3 |> filter(in_cp == 1, is_switcher == 0) |> droplevels()

# Check the sizes of the samples
samples <- list(
  `full`                                   = list(data_age1, data_age2, data_age3),
  `spillover-excluded`                     = list(data_age1_sp, data_age2_sp, data_age3_sp),
  `switcher-excluded`                      = list(data_age1_ns, data_age2_ns, data_age3_ns),
  `current pill`                           = list(data_age1_cp, data_age2_cp, data_age3_cp),
  `current pill, switcher-excluded`        = list(data_age1_cpns, data_age2_cpns, data_age3_cpns),
  `lagged pill, same rows`                 = list(data_age1_lg, data_age2_lg, data_age3_lg),
  `lagged pill, same rows, switcher-excl.` = list(data_age1_lgns, data_age2_lgns, data_age3_lgns)
)
sample_sizes <- imap_dfr(samples, \(dfs, nm) tibble(
  sample     = nm,
  age_group  = c("all_women", "teens", "young_adult"),
  n_municipal = map_int(dfs, \(x) n_distinct(x$dom_comuna)),
  n_obs      = map_int(dfs, nrow)
))
cat("\n===== Sample sizes (municipalities and municipality-years) =====\n")
sample_sizes
```

## TWFE Replication + De Chaisemartin & D'Haultfoeuille (2020) Diagnostic

### (1) Stage 1 Task 1: TWFE Replication

```{r}
# Function to compute standard errors: wild cluster bootstrap, falling back to cluster-robust (CRV1)
run_boottest <- function(model, param, cluster_var, spec_name) {

  # Try to run the wild cluster bootstrap first
  boot_obj <- tryCatch(
    {
      # boottest() draws its bootstrap weights via dqrng
      dqrng::dqset.seed(2727)

      # Swallow boottest()'s own printed diagnostics
      invisible(capture.output(
        boot_result <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(
          boottest(model, param = param, clustid = cluster_var, B = 999, nthreads = 1)
        ))
      ))

      boot_result
    },
    
    error = function(e) {
      cat(glue("[{spec_name}] failed to run wild cluster bootstrap({conditionMessage(e)}), and change to cluster-robust(CRV1) standard errors\n"))
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  # If the wild cluster bootstrap does not fail, extract the results and format them into a tibble
  if (!is.null(boot_obj)) {
    bt <- broom::tidy(boot_obj)

    result <- tibble(
      coef      = bt$estimate[1],
      se        = bt$estimate[1] / bt$statistic[1],
      p_value   = bt$p.value[1],
      ci_lower  = bt$conf.low[1],
      ci_upper  = bt$conf.high[1],
      se_method = "wild_cluster_bootstrap"
    )
  }
  # If the wild cluster bootstrap fails, fall back to cluster-robust standard errors (CRV1)
  else {
    s  <- summary(model, cluster = cluster_var)
    ct <- s$coeftable[param, ]
    ci <- confint(s)[param, ]
    result <- tibble(
      coef      = unname(ct[["Estimate"]]),
      se        = unname(ct[["Std. Error"]]),
      p_value   = unname(ct[["Pr(>|t|)"]]),
      ci_lower  = unname(ci[[1]]),
      ci_upper  = unname(ci[[2]]),
      se_method = "cluster_robust_CRV1_fallback"
    )
  }

  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
# Function to run TWFE regression with optional population weighting and wild cluster bootstrap for standard errors
run_twfe <- function(df, outcome, model_spec, baseline_only = FALSE) {

  # Data for the model
  df <- df |>
    filter(is.finite(.data[[outcome]])) |>
    group_by(dom_comuna) |>
    filter(n() > 1) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(dom_comuna = droplevels(dom_comuna))

  # Base R seed; boottest()'s own draws are seeded separately (see run_boottest())
  set.seed(2727)

  # Function to extract results from a model using wild cluster bootstrap
  extract <- function(model, spec_name) {
    run_boottest(model, "pill", "dom_comuna", spec_name) |>
      mutate(
        model_spec  = model_spec,
        outcome     = outcome,
        spec        = spec_name,
        n_obs       = nobs(model),
        n_municipal = n_distinct(df$dom_comuna[obs(model)]),
        .before = 1
      )
  }

  # Baseline model, following Table 4 column (1) of Bentancor and Clarke (2017)
  f_base <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ pill | dom_comuna + year"))
  m_base <- feols(f_base, data = df)

  # Skip the other specifications if only the baseline is needed (e.g. for the restricted sample)
  if (baseline_only) {
    return(extract(m_base, "baseline_TWFE"))
  }

  # Remaining formulas, following Table 4 columns (2) and (3), and Table 5 column (3) of Bentancor and Clarke (2017)
  f_trend <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ pill + i(dom_comuna, trend) | dom_comuna + year"))

  # Time-varying controls, following Table 4 column (3); the first party dummy is dropped to avoid the dummy variable trap
  x_vars <- grep("^X_", names(df), value = TRUE)
  x_vars <- setdiff(x_vars, grep("^X_party_", x_vars, value = TRUE)[1])
  f_cov  <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ pill +", paste(x_vars, collapse = " + "), "| dom_comuna + year"))

  m_trend   <- feols(f_trend, data = df)
  m_cov     <- feols(f_cov,   data = df)
  m_base_pw <- feols(f_base,  data = df, weights = ~popln)

  # Run the extraction function on each of the four TWFE models
  result <- bind_rows(
    extract(m_base,    "baseline_TWFE"),
    extract(m_trend,   "TWFE_with_trends"),
    extract(m_cov,     "TWFE_with_covariates"),
    extract(m_base_pw, "baseline_popln_weighted")
  )

  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
# Run the TWFE regressions for all 3 age groups and 2 outcomes
twfe_11 <- run_twfe(data_age1, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & All Age")     |> mutate(age_group = "all_women",   .before = 1)
twfe_12 <- run_twfe(data_age1, "death_rate", "Death Rate & All Age")     |> mutate(age_group = "all_women",   .before = 1)
twfe_21 <- run_twfe(data_age2, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & Teens")       |> mutate(age_group = "teens",       .before = 1)
twfe_22 <- run_twfe(data_age2, "death_rate", "Death Rate & Teens")       |> mutate(age_group = "teens",       .before = 1)
twfe_31 <- run_twfe(data_age3, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & Young Adult") |> mutate(age_group = "young_adult", .before = 1)
twfe_32 <- run_twfe(data_age3, "death_rate", "Death Rate & Young Adult") |> mutate(age_group = "young_adult", .before = 1)

results_s1t1_twfe_origin <- bind_rows(twfe_11, twfe_12, twfe_21, twfe_22, twfe_31, twfe_32)

write.csv(results_s1t1_twfe_origin, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s1t1_twfe_origin.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== Stage 1 Task 1: Baseline TWFE Estimates (6 Groups) =====\n")
results_s1t1_twfe_origin
```

### (2) Stage 1 Task 2: De Chaisemartin & D'Haultfoeuille (2020) Diagnostics

```{r}
# Function to compute the De Chaisemartin & D'Haultfoeuille (2020) TWFE diagnostics for one TWFE specification
#   spec = "baseline":        no controls, unweighted (matches the baseline TWFE model)
#   spec = "full":            with the time-varying controls X, unweighted (matches the Full Model)
#   spec = "popln_weighted":  no controls, weighted by Popln (matches the population-weighted model)
run_diagnostic <- function(df, outcome, model_spec, spec = c("baseline", "full", "popln_weighted")) {

  spec <- match.arg(spec)

  # Data for the diagnostic function
  df <- df |>
    filter(is.finite(.data[[outcome]])) |>
    group_by(dom_comuna) |>
    filter(n() > 1) |>
    ungroup() |>
    as.data.frame()

  # Time-varying controls, the same as in run_twfe()
  x_vars <- grep("^X_", names(df), value = TRUE)
  x_vars <- setdiff(x_vars, grep("^X_party_", x_vars, value = TRUE)[1])

  # Diagnostic using TwoWayFEWeights
  diag <- TwoWayFEWeights::twowayfeweights(
    data              = df,
    Y                 = outcome,
    G                 = "dom_comuna",
    T                 = "year",
    D                 = "pill",
    type              = "feTR",                                            # Use the "feTR" type for the TwoWayFEWeights diagnostic
    controls          = if (spec == "full") x_vars else NULL,              # Time-varying controls for the Full Model
    weights           = if (spec == "popln_weighted") df$popln else NULL,  # Population weights
    summary_measures  = TRUE                                               # Return summary measures for the diagnostic
  )

  # Summarize the diagnostic results into a tibble
  result <- tibble(
    model_spec     = model_spec,
    outcome        = outcome,
    spec           = spec,
    sum_plus       = diag$sum_plus,                                  # Sum of positive weights
    sum_minus      = diag$sum_minus,                                 # Sum of negative weights
    share_negative = diag$nr_minus / (diag$nr_plus + diag$nr_minus), # Share of negative weights (by number of ATT(g,t) cells)
    min_sd_flip    = diag$sensibility,                               # Minimum treatment effect standard deviation (Corollary 1)
    n_obs          = nrow(df),
    n_municipal    = n_distinct(df$dom_comuna)
  )

  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
# Run the diagnostic function for all 3 age groups and 2 outcomes
run_diagnostic_all <- function(spec) {
  bind_rows(
    run_diagnostic(data_age1, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & All Age",     spec) |> mutate(age_group = "all_women",   .before = 1),
    run_diagnostic(data_age1, "death_rate", "Death Rate & All Age",     spec) |> mutate(age_group = "all_women",   .before = 1),
    run_diagnostic(data_age2, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & Teens",       spec) |> mutate(age_group = "teens",       .before = 1),
    run_diagnostic(data_age2, "death_rate", "Death Rate & Teens",       spec) |> mutate(age_group = "teens",       .before = 1),
    run_diagnostic(data_age3, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & Young Adult", spec) |> mutate(age_group = "young_adult", .before = 1),
    run_diagnostic(data_age3, "death_rate", "Death Rate & Young Adult", spec) |> mutate(age_group = "young_adult", .before = 1)
  )
}

results_s1t2_diagnostic <- bind_rows(
  run_diagnostic_all("baseline"),
  run_diagnostic_all("full"),
  run_diagnostic_all("popln_weighted")
)

write.csv(results_s1t2_diagnostic,   paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s1t2_diagnostic.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== Stage 1 Task 2: De Chaisemartin & D'Haultfoeuille Diagnostics (Baseline, Full Model, Population-weighted) =====\n")
results_s1t2_diagnostic
```

### (3) Stage 1 Task 3: Spillover Robustness Check

#### (a) Check 1: Regression Based

```{r}
# Function to run the Full Model TWFE plus close10/close20/close30
run_twfe_close <- function(df, outcome, model_spec) {

  df <- df |>
    filter(is.finite(.data[[outcome]])) |>
    group_by(dom_comuna) |>
    filter(n() > 1) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(dom_comuna = droplevels(dom_comuna))

  set.seed(2727)

  # Time-varying controls of the Full Model
  x_vars <- grep("^X_", names(df), value = TRUE)
  x_vars <- setdiff(x_vars, grep("^X_party_", x_vars, value = TRUE)[1])

  f_close <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ pill +", paste(x_vars, collapse = " + "), "+ close10 + close20 + close30 | dom_comuna + year"))
  m_close <- feols(f_close, data = df)

  run_boottest(m_close, "pill", "dom_comuna", "TWFE_close_controls") |>
    mutate(
      model_spec  = model_spec,
      outcome     = outcome,
      spec        = "TWFE_close_controls",
      n_obs       = nobs(m_close),
      n_municipal = n_distinct(df$dom_comuna[obs(m_close)]),
      .before = 1
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Run the Full Model close-controls TWFE regression for all 3 age groups and 2 outcomes
close_11 <- run_twfe_close(data_age1, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & All Age")     |> mutate(age_group = "all_women",   .before = 1)
close_12 <- run_twfe_close(data_age1, "death_rate", "Death Rate & All Age")     |> mutate(age_group = "all_women",   .before = 1)
close_21 <- run_twfe_close(data_age2, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & Teens")       |> mutate(age_group = "teens",       .before = 1)
close_22 <- run_twfe_close(data_age2, "death_rate", "Death Rate & Teens")       |> mutate(age_group = "teens",       .before = 1)
close_31 <- run_twfe_close(data_age3, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & Young Adult") |> mutate(age_group = "young_adult", .before = 1)
close_32 <- run_twfe_close(data_age3, "death_rate", "Death Rate & Young Adult") |> mutate(age_group = "young_adult", .before = 1)

results_s1t3a_spillover_close <- bind_rows(close_11, close_12, close_21, close_22, close_31, close_32)
write.csv(results_s1t3a_spillover_close, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s1t3a_spillover_close.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== Stage 1 Task 3, Check 1: Full Model TWFE with Close Controls, Full Sample (6 Groups) =====\n")
results_s1t3a_spillover_close
```

```{r}
# Coefficients on close10, close20 and close30 in the same regression
run_close_betas <- function(df, outcome, age_group) {

  df <- df |>
    filter(is.finite(.data[[outcome]])) |>
    group_by(dom_comuna) |>
    filter(n() > 1) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(dom_comuna = droplevels(dom_comuna))

  x_vars <- grep("^X_", names(df), value = TRUE)
  x_vars <- setdiff(x_vars, grep("^X_party_", x_vars, value = TRUE)[1])

  m_close <- feols(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ pill +", paste(x_vars, collapse = " + "), "+ close10 + close20 + close30 | dom_comuna + year")), data = df)

  map_dfr(c("close10", "close20", "close30"), \(v) {
    run_boottest(m_close, v, "dom_comuna", "TWFE_close_controls") |> mutate(variable = v, .before = 1)
  }) |>
    mutate(age_group = age_group, outcome = outcome, .before = 1) |>
    select(age_group, outcome, variable, coef, se, p_value)
}

close_betas <- bind_rows(
  run_close_betas(data_age1, "birth_rate", "all_women"),
  run_close_betas(data_age1, "death_rate", "all_women"),
  run_close_betas(data_age2, "birth_rate", "teens"),
  run_close_betas(data_age2, "death_rate", "teens"),
  run_close_betas(data_age3, "birth_rate", "young_adult"),
  run_close_betas(data_age3, "death_rate", "young_adult")
)

cat("\n===== Stage 1 Task 3, Check 1: Coefficients on close10, close20 and close30 (6 Groups) =====\n")
close_betas |> mutate(across(c(coef, se, p_value), \(x) round(x, 3)))
```

```{r}
twfe_cpns_31 <- run_twfe(data_age3_cpns, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & Young Adult") |> mutate(age_group = "young_adult", .before = 1)
twfe_cpns_32 <- run_twfe(data_age3_cpns, "death_rate", "Death Rate & Young Adult") |> mutate(age_group = "young_adult", .before = 1)

results_s1t5b_twfe_cpns <- bind_rows(twfe_cpns_11, twfe_cpns_12, twfe_cpns_21, twfe_cpns_22, twfe_cpns_31, twfe_cpns_32)

write.csv(results_s1t5b_twfe_cpns, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s1t5b_twfe_cpns.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== Stage 1 Task 5b: TWFE Estimates (4 Specifications) with the Current-Year Pill, Switcher-Excluded (6 Groups) =====\n")
results_s1t5b_twfe_cpns
```
